title: Ultrahuman scroll reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it 24px (or 12px) into place as it scrolls into view, with optional stagger steps. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation.
notes: CSS only (animation-timeline: view()); older browsers and reduced motion show content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box: use overflow-clip, or the timeline freezes
